fact: A giant planet candidate at Hamal — the Ram's star that once marked the spring equinox.
bio: Hamal (Alpha Arietis), the brightest star of Aries, anchored the vernal equinox two thousand years ago and still lends its name to the zero-point of the sky. A planet nearly twice Jupiter’s mass has been inferred from the orange giant's motion, placing another world around one of the zodiac's oldest landmark stars.
